reviewer_role: Project owner manual rubric review, AI-assisted

decisions.rationale: The cited Timure draft explicitly requests immediate human verification of road and bridge access impacts before action, retains human authority, and references the saved CEMS snapshot.
The cited Bidur draft explicitly requests immediate, location-specific residential-impact triage using source-reported affected building and population facts.

Syapru Besi is present only in an immediate access and residential-triage proposal. Although its saved impact record reports affected power plant constructions and a school, the run contains no named Syapru Besi critical-services continuity check within six hours.
The Bharatpur draft remains monitor-only, preserves the waiting-for-data state, and requests the missing product rather than inferring no impact.
